context: Evaluates correct implementation of the AI brand extraction API functions from visionarias-client. Tests cover correct endpoint targeting, Bearer token authentication, JSON vs FormData content-type handling for extractFullBrand, and the visual vs full extraction distinction.

checklist.name: extractBrandIdentity endpoint
checklist.description: extractBrandIdentity sends a POST request to the correct AI actions endpoint for visual brand extraction

checklist.name: extractBrandIdentity JSON body
checklist.description: extractBrandIdentity sends { url, type } as a JSON body with Content-Type: application/json

checklist.name: Bearer auth on both functions
checklist.description: Both extractBrandIdentity and extractFullBrand include Authorization: Bearer <token> in the request headers

checklist.name: extractFullBrand JSON path
checklist.description: When data is a plain object, extractFullBrand calls JSON.stringify on it and sets Content-Type: application/json

checklist.name: extractFullBrand FormData path
checklist.description: When data is a FormData instance, extractFullBrand passes it directly as the body WITHOUT setting Content-Type (letting the browser handle multipart boundaries)
